q: How much CO2 does grinding barite for drilling mud emit per tonne?
title: Barite grinding CO2 per tonne
short: Grinding to drilling grade fineness is most of it: mill electricity times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, divided by tonnes. Add mining diesel and freight to the buyer. Barite is not a CBAM good, but oilfield buyers increasingly ask for a figure.
audience: Barite miners and grinding units supplying oilfield services

ul: Tonnes dispatched at the specified density grade.

p: Oilfield service companies count your figure in their Scope 3 Category 1. Give it per tonne with the grade named.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
